question: Can this diagnostic prove r4 outperforms r5 or quantify affected users and engineering benefit after the rebuild?

criteria.instruction: No. The example mixes pB queries with pA documents and lacks a complete matched-profile pB test or representative relevance/traffic dataset. A successful consistency migration establishes compatible profiles and coverage, not measured relevance, answer truth or engineering benefit.
Use the selected diagnostic and evidence-limits document; name missing held-out relevance tests, matched-profile evaluation and representative traffic/outcome evidence.
Decline a model quality ranking, affected-user percentage and engineering-benefit estimate. Do not use cross-profile cosine as calibrated confidence.
